claims.text: Equiatomic cast HfNbTaTiZr has 8–16% room-temperature tensile ductility.
Equiatomic cast HfNbTaTiZr has a high-temperature yield strength of 163–530 MPa.
Equiatomic cast HfNbTaTiZr has inadequate oxygen resistance.
Surface aluminization of equiatomic cast HfNbTaTiZr will produce a thin aluminum-rich surface layer.
The aluminized surface will form a continuous, adherent Al2O3 scale during high-temperature exposure.
Introduced aluminum will react preferentially with oxygen to form Al2O3.
The Al2O3 scale will act as a diffusion barrier that impedes oxygen ingress.
Impeded oxygen ingress will retard oxidation and pesting of equiatomic cast HfNbTaTiZr.
Surface aluminization will leave the alloy's bulk microstructure intact.
After static-air exposure at approximately 800 °C for 5 hours, aluminized material will have a lower oxide-scale thickness than untreated material.
After static-air exposure at approximately 800 °C for 5 hours, aluminized material will have lower oxidation weight gain than untreated material.
Aluminized material will maintain room-temperature ductility relative to untreated material.
Aluminized material will maintain high-temperature yield strength relative to untreated material.
Untreated equiatomic cast HfNbTaTiZr undergoes rapid oxidation under static air at approximately 800 °C for 5 hours.
Untreated equiatomic cast HfNbTaTiZr undergoes pesting under static air at approximately 800 °C for 5 hours.
